name: Sunshine Task Force Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Sunshine Task Force
  Committee will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will
  address the agenda listed below:

  City Hall
  455 North Rexford Drive
  4^*^ Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Wednesday, February 13, 2019
  4:00 p.m.

  AGENDA

1)  Public Comment
  Members of the public will be given an opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  items not listed on the agenda.

2)  Follow Up Items from the Last Meeting
  a. Director of Community Development, Susan Healy Keene, re: Use of the
  Discretionary Process in Planning:
  1. Review of Revised Projects List. Based on Comments/Requests Received at the
  January Meeting, to Include the Current Status of where Each Project is in the
  Process, Highlight which Projects Exceed Code Requirements, and Add FAR
  Calculation for the 9900 Wilshire Blvd. Project

  b. City Attorney, re: Expansion of the "Enforcement" Section in the
  Commissions' "Rules of Procedure," Establishing a Clear and Unambiguous 4-
  Step Process to Remove a Disruptive Individual from a Commission Meeting
  1. Revisions to Steve Mayer's Proposed Guidelines for Removing a Disruptive
  Member of the Public from a Meeting to be in Conformance with the Law, in
  Accordance with the Sunshine Task Force Direction

3)  Adjournment

Michael Dunn, Records Manager

Posted: February 8, 2019

  . f 6.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, 4"^ Floor Conference Room A is wheelchair accessible.
 If you need special assistance to attend this meeting, please call the City Manager's Office at (310) 285-1014
  orTTY (310) 285-6881. Please notify the City Manager's Office at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the
  meeting if you require captioning service so that reasonable arrangements can be made.
